post.title: No state income tax doesn't mean you pay less tax
post.ig:
No state income tax doesn't mean you pay less tax.

In 2026, 9 states don't tax wages: AK, FL, NV, NH, SD, TN, TX, WA, WY (Washington taxes some capital gains; a 2028 tax on income over $1M faced a Nov 2026 repeal vote).
The money comes from elsewhere: Tennessee's average combined sales tax is 9.61%, 2nd-highest in the US (Tax Foundation, Jan 2026). Texas homeowners paid about 1.36% of home value in property tax in 2023, 7th-highest.
In Florida, the lowest-earning 20% pay 13.2% of income in state and local taxes vs 2.7% for the top 1% (ITEP Who Pays, 2024).

Sources: Tax Foundation, ITEP Who Pays? 7th edition (Jan 2024).
News and education, not financial advice.
